summary: Iteration 6 — Partial & Multi-Location Racking. Backend: 14/14 pytest cases PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_partial_racking.py covering status migration (no legacy 'RACKED'), RACKING_PENDING/PARTIALLY_RACKED/FULLY_RACKED transitions, ?not_status= filter (single + CSV), /prepare/{rn_id} with received_qty/already_racked_qty/pending_qty + skip-zero-pending behavior, /prepare?exclude_rkn_id= for edit mode, POST cumulative validation (over-alloc -> 400 with part_no in detail), single-RKN multi-location split (one item across two godown/rack/box rows), PUT cumulative excluding self, /record flips ONLY the RKN (RN stays PARTIAL when other items still pending), DELETE recomputes RN status, RN edit/delete blocked (409) when ANY RKN exists. Frontend: status badges 3-color verified (amber/blue/green-when-fully), edit/delete disabled for non-RACKING_PENDING RNs, RN dropdown excludes FULLY_RACKED but includes PARTIALLY_RACKED, pending hints render 'Pending X of Y' per row with default qty=pending, +Split duplicates row (qty=0, location empty, existing-locations chips preserved on both rows), over-allocation client-side check fires red row + 'Over 11/10' indicator on BOTH split rows that share part_no/make, save with over-alloc/empty-loc shows toast and stays on form. 0 console errors throughout.

critical_code_review_comments: Cumulative validation logic (_validate_cumulative_qty) correctly aggregates across DRAFT + RECORDED RKNs and uses 1e-6 tolerance for float qty - safe.
_recompute_rn_status reverts racked_at when RN goes from FULLY_RACKED back to PARTIAL/PENDING (e.g., on RKN delete or qty reduction in PUT) — good idempotent behavior.
Startup migration: db.receipt_notes update_many({status: RACKED}) -> FULLY_RACKED + recomputes for all RNs - correct & idempotent on restarts.
On record(), RN status no longer auto-flips to RACKED — only the RKN flips. RN status stays whatever cumulative qty implies (PARTIAL or FULLY_RACKED). This decoupling matches spec exactly.
Frontend client-side over-alloc check correctly groups by (part_no, make) across all rows in the form — verified by both split rows turning red when qty[0]=11 even though qty[1]=0.

Minor UX: when a row has BOTH missing location AND over-allocation, the save handler reports the location-missing toast first. Functionally correct (both block save) but user has to fix one issue, retry, then see the next. Could combine messages or list all issues at once. Not blocking.

Minor: prepare endpoint returns existing_locations even for items with pending_qty=0 hidden cases — these are skipped server-side (verified) which is the right call to avoid showing locked rows in edit form.
